name: Chi-Square Goodness-of-Fit Test for Noise
aliases: Chi-Square Goodness-of-Fit Test for Noise Quality
definition: A tool by Yoon et al. to measure the quality of the amplitude distribution of noise within an optimization procedure.
summary: The Chi-Square Goodness-of-Fit Test for Noise measures amplitude distribution quality by comparing sampled values to a theoretical distribution, distinguishing itself by focusing solely on statistical fidelity rather than spatial frequency.
